requirements.title: AIMAG result is real with Z kind
requirements.definition: AIMAG returns a real result with the same kind type parameter as Z.

pending.result-real-type: Assign AIMAG(CMPLX(2.0,3.0)) to a real sentinel initialized to -777.0 and assert the result is a real value equal to 3.0 exactly for these decimal literals.
pending.result-same-kind-as-z: Call AIMAG(CMPLX(2.0,-3.0)) and assert KIND(result)==KIND(AIMAG(CMPLX(0.0,1.0))) together with exact value -3.0; a future extended-kind fixture may add coverage, but the default-kind equality is the portable oracle for this source facet.
